privacy.contact: Questions about your data? Reach out at the support address listed in Settings → About.
privacy.cookies: We use two strictly necessary cookies: one to keep you logged in (HttpOnly, can't be read by JavaScript) and one for CSRF protection. Neither is used for tracking or advertising — this app has no analytics, ads, or third-party trackers.
privacy.dataCollected: Username and a securely hashed password (we never store your plain-text password). An optional email address, used solely for password-reset links. AI provider API keys you choose to connect, encrypted with AES-256 before storage. Your saved forecasts, portfolio analyses, and community sentiment votes.
privacy.intro: This page explains what data AI Crypto Analytics collects, why, and how it's protected. This is a demo/educational project, not a commercial service — but we take the same care with your data regardless.
privacy.rights: You can delete any saved forecast/portfolio analysis, disconnect any API key, or clear your email at any time from within the app. To request full account deletion, contact us using the details below.
privacy.thirdParty: Market data comes from CoinGecko and Alternative.me (Fear & Greed Index) — no personal data is sent to them. If you connect your own AI provider API key, your prompts (coin names, portfolio composition) are sent directly to that provider (Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek or xAI) under their own privacy terms.

terms.notAdvice: All forecasts, portfolio recommendations and sentiment analysis — whether AI-generated or demo/mock data — are for informational and educational purposes only.
